Students must complete a minimum of 120 units with a Pacific cumulative and program grade point average of 2.0 in order to earn the Bachelor of Music degree in Performance (Strings).

","groupId":"1168b127-babb-4506-8288-01956da7c307","position":1,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"General Education Requirements","groupId":"6392622e-04b3-47fa-9112-01956da7c308","position":2,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

For more details, see General Education

Minimum 28 units and 9 courses that include the following requirements.

","groupId":"a97480c3-3205-4ee7-9851-01956da7c308","position":3,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"CORE Requirements","groupId":"a5f57044-dbaa-4ca5-9e10-01956da7c308","position":4,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

1) CORE Seminars cannot be taken for Pass/No Credit. 

2) Transfer students with 28 or more transfer credits taken after high school are exempt from both CORE seminars.

All students must complete Diversity and Inclusion coursework (at least 3 units)

Students must demonstrate competence in:

Writing

Quantitative Analysis (Math)

Note: 1) Failure to satisfy the fundamental skills requirements by the end of four semesters of full-time study at the University is grounds for academic disqualification.

","groupId":"13e0583c-6712-4c4f-af8d-01956dbd2cf7","position":11,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Major Requirements","groupId":"124e86fc-dd3a-4629-b72a-01956dbd2cf7","position":12,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Students are required to take:

1) 8 semesters of at least 21 units and up to 32 units of MAPM.

2) 8 units and 8 semesters of MPER, based on placement auditions.

3) MPER 060 for 6 semesters.

4) A maximum of 5 elective units.

5) A maximum of 18 Music electives.
